verdict.rationale: The evidence documents only aggregate engagement data through the API: per-broadcast stats, per-link click counts for a broadcast, and account-level sent/opened/clicked totals. Nothing shows an endpoint that returns what a single subscriber was sent, opened, or clicked. Aggregate stats and the pricing-page 'engagement scoring' feature are adjacent capabilities, not per-contact engagement history via the API.

support.subject: As a developer, I can read per-person engagement history — what was sent, opened, clicked — through the API for any contact
